decks.notes: The primary focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing lands as both resources and disruption tools. By using cards like Crop Rotation, Life from the Loam, and Exploration, the player can create a powerful land base while also disrupting their opponent's strategy with cards like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter. The deck also has the potential to quickly assemble the Dark Depths/Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent by leveraging the power of lands in a strategic and controlling manner.

The main concept of this deck is to use the combo strategy of reanimating powerful creatures from the graveyard, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. The deck also includes cards like Brainstorm, Thoughtseize, and Force of Will for card advantage and protection. The deck utilizes a mix of control elements like Daze and Wasteland to disrupt opponents while setting up its combo pieces.Overall, the deck aims to quickly bring out powerful threats and overwhelm the opponent with its reanimation strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Nethergoyf and Orcish Bowmasters. The strategy focuses on tempo plays with cards like Daze and Thoughtseize to control the pace of the game. It also includes powerful threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Murktide Regent to close out games quickly. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and countermagic like Force of Will to protect its creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of the deck is to utilize Mystic Forge in combination with artifact mana ramp and ways to untap artifacts to generate infinite mana and card advantage. The deck aims to assemble the Mystic Forge combo quickly to overwhelm the opponent with powerful artifact spells and abilities, leveraging cards like Grim Monolith, Voltaic Key, and Basalt Monolith to generate mana and use Mystic Forge's ability to play cards off the top of the library. Karn, the Great Creator and Ugin, Eye of the Storms provide additional utility and threat in the deck.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through a mix of counterspells, removal, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Teferi and versatile threats like Uro to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent. The deck also has access to versatile creatures like Endurance and powerful disruption like Leyline Binding. By managing resources efficiently and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to outlast and outmaneuver the opponent until it can establish a dominant position and secure victory.

The deck focuses on a fast and explosive combo that aims to quickly mill the entire library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle. Cards like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer are used to rapidly mill cards, while spells like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help generate the necessary mana to cast multiple spells in a single turn. The deck sacrifices traditional creature and sorcery spells for a streamlined approach to winning the game as quickly as possible through a high-risk, high-reward strategy.

The main strategy of this deck is to use cards like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack to quickly get powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield. Additionally, the use of cards like Omniscience and Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the board and set up devastating combos. By using cards like Ponder and Brainstorm, the deck is able to find the necessary pieces quickly and effectively, allowing for explosive plays and overwhelming the opponent. Overall, this deck aims to win the game through high-powered creatures and fast, decisive plays.

The main concept of this deck involves using efficient disruption and card selection spells to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, only to bring them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes cards like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower for additional threats and disruption, as well as Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student for card advantage. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan with countermagic and discard spells.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy with disruptive spells like Daze and Thoughtseize while quickly deploying aggressive threats like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Nethergoyf. The deck aims to control the game tempo by efficiently using removal spells such as Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, as well as countermagic like Force of Will. Additionally, the deck utilizes card draw and selection with Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure consistent draws and maintain pressure on the opponent. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan with a mix of dual lands and utility lands like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing counterspells and card draw to maintain tempo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It also incorporates ramp spells like "Up the Beanstalk" and "Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath" to accelerate mana development. Additionally, it includes powerful removal spells like "Swords to Plowshares" and disruptive creatures like "Endurance" to handle threats from the opponent. The deck's mana base is designed to support its multi-color requirements, providing flexibility and consistency in casting its spells.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Skyclave Apparition while simultaneously applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Flickerwisp and Overlord of the Balemurk. It also utilizes synergy with cards like Stoneforge Mystic to search for key equipment such as Kaldra Compleat. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and includes powerful lands like Karakas and Wasteland. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad allows for additional value through flickering creatures and gaining card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain control over the game using counterspells, removal, and card advantage to limit the opponent's options and secure victory through incremental advantage. The deck utilizes a mix of efficient creatures like Murktide Regent and Cori-Steel Cutter along with versatile spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to control the board. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage while Teferi, Time Raveler disrupts the opponent's strategy. The land base includes Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary to further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck aims to quickly get a big creature into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Griselbrand, then use reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield. It also includes cards like Unmask and Cabal Therapy to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck has a focus on powerful creatures with abilities that can swing the game in your favor, such as Archon of Cruelty and Borborygmos Enraged. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with these threats and win the game before they can respond effectively.

This deck focuses on using Entomb and Reanimate to quickly bring powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. It also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo and interact with the opponent. The deck aims to win the game by reanimating threats faster than the opponent can answer them, while utilizing cards like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary combo pieces. It also includes some backup threats like Brazen Borrower and Orcish Bowmasters to provide additional options for victory.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the Painter combo using cards like Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library. The deck also includes support cards like Goblin Engineer and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to help find and protect the combo pieces. Additionally, cards like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt provide disruption and removal, while Urza's Saga and Ancient Tomb help ramp up mana production. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The deck is focused on quickly assembling a powerful graveyard-based combo using cards like Balustrade Spy, Undercity Informer, and Dread Return to put the entire library into the graveyard and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Jack-o'-Lantern. The deck utilizes fast mana like Lotus Petal and Simian Spirit Guide to accelerate its game plan and protect itself with Pact of Negation. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Cabal Therapy and Chancellor of the Annex to disrupt the opponent's game plan while going off.
